# Ledger: the Mark pilot (bdoor)

Every historical claim in the new teaching on Mark's book page
(`client/public/bible/notes/mark/intro.json`, field `teaching`) and in the plain
notes on Mark 1 to 3 (`client/public/bible/notes/mark/plain/1.json` to `3.json`),
with the source it rests on and how it was checked. Searches were run on
2026-11-18. Direct page fetches were blocked on this machine, so checks rest on
search results that quote or summarise the source, cross-read against at least
two results where possible. Where a result could not give exact wording, the
site paraphrases and does not quote.

Scripture is quoted from the Berean Standard Bible files in the repository
(`client/public/bible/ch/`) and checked word for word by
`scripts/validate-bible-notes.mjs`. Counts of Greek words come from the same
files' Greek text.

## The plain notes on Psalms 11 to 41: the lighter shape (2026-11-19)

From Psalm 11 on, most psalms have one passage for the whole psalm and a
`hard` part only where the psalm has a difficulty of its own (the validator,
the type and the page already allowed `hard` to be absent: Psalm 8:1-2 had
none). Scripture is the BSB in the repository, checked by a strict script
(case and punctuation kept, no em-dash, no "..." inside a quotation) as well
as by the validator. "Repository deep note" means the existing note at
`client/public/bible/notes/psalms/<n>.json`.

## 2 Thessalonians complete (2026-11-20)

All three chapters in plain words. No web searches for this book. One sentence on the book
page (the part on 2:1-12) was changed in the chapter 2 commit, to match the chapter: it no
longer says that everyone who named the figure ‘has been wrong’, since that would take a
side against readings that place him in Paul's own century; it now says that those who
named someone of their own day and expected the end at once saw the end not come.
